title: Invasive ductal carcinoma, ER and PR positive, HER2 negative
notice: Synthetic and AI-written. Needs review by a pathologist before being used to score anything (issue #22).

keys.span: Invasive means the cancer cells have grown out of the milk duct into the surrounding breast tissue
keys.correct: Invasive carcinoma has grown beyond the duct into the surrounding breast tissue.
keys.speaker: doctor

keys.span: Because it's HER2 negative, hormone-blocking pills won't work for you.
keys.issue: Mixes up HER2 with hormone receptors: hormone therapy depends on ER and PR, not HER2.
keys.correct: Whether hormone therapy helps depends on ER and PR. ER and PR positive means endocrine therapy is likely to help. HER2 negative means HER2-targeted drugs such as trastuzumab aren't used.
keys.source_hint: ASCO/CAP ER/PgR and HER2 testing guidelines
keys.speaker: doctor

keys.issue: The grade is stated but not explained.
keys.correct: The Nottingham grade, 1 to 3, describes how abnormal the cells look and how fast they are likely to grow. It is not the stage.
keys.source_hint: CAP invasive breast carcinoma protocol (Nottingham grade)
keys.speaker: doctor
